Hardy:
You can survive injuries that would kill lesser people.

Your maximum health is increased by 20
Battle-scarred:
Not even the most greivous wounds have kept you down for long.

You regenerate 100% more health per second and the amount of time before your health begins regenerating is reduced by 50%
Pile the Bodies High:
You're a fearsome combatant and the police grow increasingly hesitant in pursuing you for fear of adding to your extensive body count.

Police search duration is capped at 35 seconds.

If Blood Rush is unlocked, each officer you've killed further reduces the search timer by 0.1 seconds for a maximum reduction of 10 seconds.
Quick Draw McGraw:
You're the fastest gunslinger in the West(ville).

Aim time for ranged weapons is reduced by 50%.
Sharpshooter:
You could shoot a fly off a horse's ass at a hundred paces.

Reduces the minimum and maximum spread of ranged weapons by 65%.
Ghost:
You always stay low-profile and apply a light touch.

Your visibility is reduced by 25% and pickpocketing items is much easier.
Slippery:
You're an expert at keeping out of reach and breaking the tightest grips.

Reduces police arrest radius by 25% and increases time until arrested by 100%.
Fleet Feet: Increase movement speed by 15% per level.
Spring-Heeled: Increase max stamina by 30% and jump height by 35%.
Prison Wallet:
Increase item stack size by 100% per level.

Does not apply to items with a stack size of 1.
Double-Stack Mags: Increase ammo capacity of ranged weapons and magazines by 100%.
Circadian Mastery:
You have achieved complete mastery of your sleep cycle.

You are able to sleep while Athletic or Energizing effects are active and can use a bed to rest until the next time period.

Plants only grow at 33% of their normal speed when time is skipped.
Combat Experience:
Killing the following NPCs grants XP
- Police Officer: +12 XP
- Cartel Goon: +20 XP
- Cartel Dealer: +30 XP
Pitchin' a Tent: Increase plant quality for grow tents by 26%.
Advanced Pot Techniques:
Rank 1: Increase plant quality for all pots by 15%.

Rank 2: Increase plant quality for air pots by an additional 20%.
Harder and Stronger: Increase meth and cocaine quality by 1.
Wet-Ass Plants: Moisture drains 50% slower for all grow containers.
Absorbent Soil: Soil additives last until the soil is depleted.
Green Thumb: Increase plant and mushroom growth speed 5%.
Quick Crafter: Increase the speed of cauldrons, chemistry stations, lab ovens, and mixing stations by 100%.
Bountiful Harvest: Increase base yield of plants by 1.
Crankin' One Out: Increase the production capacity of mixing stations and drying racks by 100%.
Witch's Brew: Increase the output of the cauldron by 100%.
Apprenticeship:
- Planting seeds/spores grants 2 XP
- Harvesting plants grants an additional 200% XP
- Harvesting mushrooms grants the same XP as plants
- Producing drugs and precursors grants 5 XP
- Packaging drugs grants 1 XP per product
- Mixing grants 1 XP per product
- Creating new mixes grants an additional 25% XP.
Silver Tongued Devil: Increase chance a potential customer will accept a free sample by 5%
Community Service:
Through your experience in gathering trash, you've become more adept at picking up and storing trash.

Trash grabbers now pick up trash in a radius roughly equal to a trash bag and can store twice as many items.
Sacar La Basura:
You have the uncanny ability to convince people that your trash is their treasure

Trash is worth $1 more per level and pawned items are worth 25% more per level
Spread the Wealth: Increase citizens' weekly spending limits by 25% per level.
Captive Market: Increase citizens' weekly order limits by 3 per skill level and 1 per player rank.
Hoard the Wealth: Increase ATM deposit limit by $2500 per level.
Crystal Ball:
Your haggling prowess is borderline mystical.

You can see the chance of a customer accepting a counteroffer.
Informant:
You know a guy who knows a guy that knows a guy that knows the best ways to avoid law enforcement.

Police are shown on the map.
Spymaster:
Your eyes and ears are everywhere.

Benzies are shown on the map.
Grifter:
- Gain 200% more XP from successful counteroffers
- Gain 10% of a drug sale's value as bonus XP.
Reliable Business Partner: Increase dead drop order limit by 67.5% and item limit by 50%.
Rush Delivery:
Reduces delivery time

Minimum: 60 minutes -> 30 minutes

Maximum: 6 hours -> 2 hours.
Motivational Leader: Increase the movement speed of dealers by 100%.
Fast Farmers: Botanists perform all actions twice as fast.
Fast Handlers: Packagers perform all actions twice as fast.
Fast Chemists: Chemists perform all actions twice as fast.
Night Shift: Employees don't stop working at 4 AM.
Overworked and Underpaid: Increase station assignment limit for botanists and chemists by 2.
Good Samaritan:
Once per day, destroy all trash on the map and gain 100% of the sell value as online balance.

Default keybind is F1.
Blood Rush:
Active ability: Once per day, fully restore health and gain Blood Rush for 60 seconds.

Passive ability: Gain 0.1 max health for every police officer or cartel member killed, up to 30 health.

While Blood Rush is active, the passive health cap is doubled to 60 health and health regen delay is reduced by 80% (90% with Battle-Scarred).

Default keybind is F2.
Siphon Funds:
Once per day, instantly collect your money from all dealers. 10% + 5% per owned business of collected money is converted to online balance.

Default keybind is F3.
Trickle-down Economics:
Once per day, instantly deposit your cash in all owned businesses for laundering while keeping a minimum in reserve.

Laundering operations now pay out in increments of 25% every 6 hours instead of 100% every 24 hours.

Default keybind is F4.
Blood Money:
Once per day, for 30 seconds your health cannot drop below 1 and you gain 100% of all damage received and dealt as cash.

Default keybind is F5.
Infectious Personality:
Once per day, all NPCs within 15 meters are randomly afflicted with Toxic or Explosive.

Characters afflicted with Toxic die after 8 seconds, characters afflicted with Explosive explode and die after 30 seconds.

Upon death, the effect is spread to nearby characters and half of their health is gained as cash and online balance.

Default keybind is F6.
Adrenaline Surge:
Three times per day, your movement speed and jump height are tripled for 15 seconds.

Default keybind is F7.
Anti-Gravity Bong:
Once every 60 seconds, place a special anti-gravity bong that ragdolls and flings away any NPC within a 10 meter radius.

Lasts for 15 seconds. When the skill expires, the bong pulls NPCs towards itself and explodes.

Default keybind is F8.
